literal_meaning: এক এক (প্রত্যেকটি আলাদা করে বা একের পর এক)
figurative_meaning_en: Irregularly or occasionally; a reduplicative form indicating intermittency
example_sentences_in_bangla: একেক দিন কলে জল আসে না।
একেকবার মনে হয় যে সে আসবে।
example_sentences_in_english: Water doesn't come to the pond every day.
Sometimes it seems like he will come.
note: This is a common reduplicative structure in Bengali for expressing irregularity, rooted in everyday rural observations.
